_notes.purpose: Milestone 1 — demonstrates Webhook, HTTP Request, and Email Send nodes
how_to_test_webhook_without_email: 2. Click 'Test Workflow' (do NOT activate yet — test mode uses /webhook-test/ URL)
3. In a terminal or Postman: curl -X POST http://localhost:5678/webhook-test/analyze-test
4. Watch n8n UI — you should see the webhook fire and the HTTP Request execute
5. Email node will fail until SMTP credentials are configured — that is expected
how_to_setup_gmail_smtp: 1. Google Account > Security > 2-Step Verification (enable if not on)
2. Google Account > Security > App Passwords > generate one for 'Mail'
3. In n8n: Settings > Credentials > New > SMTP
User: your Gmail address | Password: the App Password (16 chars)
4. Save credential, copy its ID, replace REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_SMTP_CREDENTIAL_ID above
